title: Accessibility, Multiview Authoring, Performance & Recovery
delivered_capability: Normalizes keyboard, touch, pen and nonvisual authoring to equivalent governed semantic operation identities without making a visual modality authoritative.
Projects map, semantic-list, topology and history-state views over shared stable semantic references without creating per-view canonical truth.
Processes large maps and deep topology with deterministic bounded batches and stable serialization rather than timing-dependent correctness.
Returns explicit owner-version conflicts and versioned/idempotent undo or recovery proposals without silently mutating or rolling back canonical owner state.

Filters hidden or restricted semantics before projection, preserves accessible nonvisual summaries for consequential work, and introduces no durable SSA-09 ledger, migration 0022, provider activation or successor ownership.
